event: US jobs report Fri 6 Nov, 15:30 SAST

bullets.title: Dollar weak
bullets.text: DXY near 101.3, a one-month low after Democrats won Congress. A weaker dollar helps gold.

bullets.title: Yields eased
bullets.text: after the vote (10-year about 4.88%), which lowers the cost of holding gold.

bullets.title: Headwind
bullets.text: markets price about 80% odds of a Fed hike on 8-9 Dec. That caps rallies.

bullets.title: Big buyers
bullets.text: central banks bought 321 t in Q3 (+42% y/y); gold ETFs at record holdings.

bullets.title: Oil fell ~9%
bullets.text: on US-Iran deal hopes, which cools inflation fears.

bullets.title: Price
bullets.text: biggest one-day jump since August on Wed (+3.5%), now at the highest since 22 Oct, testing 4,146.

bullets.title: Friday payrolls
bullets.text: decides it: strong jobs = dollar up, gold toward 4,000. Weak jobs = gold toward 4,225.

A strong jobs report on Friday (above the 65k forecast).
A 4H close back below 4,075, which flips the picture bearish.
